materialChanges: MiniCPM-o 4.5 and PersonaPlex full-duplex serving graduate out of experimental and the realtime stack adds a Python DuplexClient API
server-side VAD is added for turn-based omni models with explicit turn and interrupt constraints
Nemotron VoiceChat gains native vLLM talker execution with paged attention, CUDA Graphs and realtime startup warmup
diffusion gains BAGEL continuous batching, Boogu request batching and CFG parallelism, SANA-Video tensor/sequence/CFG parallelism and component-selective offload
parallel_stage_init adds opt-in colocated-stage initialization with memory-admission and device-phase locking semantics
paged AR-to-DiT KV transfer uses the native Mooncake connector but upstream states end-to-end completion handling is not yet complete
diffusion_batch_size is removed and max_num_seqs becomes the single diffusion batching configuration
new audiovisual/image/speech integrations expand the execution surface but require separate model-specific rights and qualification
acceptance: Bind exact tag commit aff7d64948f6c0e81e9b3272234623044e215967 plus the exact package or container digest actually executed; capture Python, dependency, CUDA, driver and accelerator identity.
Keep the prerelease isolated from production and compare it against the currently admitted multimodal serving baseline; an RC result cannot change routes or defaults.

Exercise duplex and realtime correctness for MiniCPM-o 4.5, PersonaPlex and Nemotron VoiceChat where prerequisites exist, including session concurrency, turn boundaries, server VAD, cancellation, playback state, long-context behavior, restart and failure cases; record UNAVAILABLE where prerequisites are absent.

Evaluate BAGEL continuous batching, Boogu batching and CFG parallelism, SANA-Video TP/SP/CFG parallelism and component-selective offload as separate measured paths with correctness, latency, throughput, memory and rollback evidence.
Exercise parallel_stage_init only as opt-in and compare it with serial initialization while validating memory-admission and device-lock failure behavior.
Treat paged AR-to-DiT Mooncake transfer as partial until an actual end-to-end completion witness exists; release notes alone cannot qualify completion.
Add a deterministic migration regression proving diffusion_batch_size is rejected or migrated explicitly and max_num_seqs semantics are preserved; no silent configuration reinterpretation.
Keep model-specific licenses, remote-code requirements, voice-cloning/privacy constraints and weight rights as independent gates; do not rehost upstream weights for inventory.
Preserve current rollback/fallback, provenance, receipts, security controls and branch protections. Upstream performance claims or model support do not grant production authority.

reuse the admitted plain vLLM 0.29 source/runtime boundary where applicable but do not conflate plain-serving qualification with multimodal-runtime qualification
add deterministic migration, duplex/VAD, initialization and rollback negatives before any runtime recommendation
retain missing models, hardware or provider capabilities as UNAVAILABLE rather than simulating passes
